findings.what: The recovery moved successful README completion and portable output-link projection from `write_report` to `WorkflowRunner`, then deleted the old success/link assertions without re-homing them in the public completed-demo test. Add assertions after public P7 completion for `Status: complete`, `Last completed phase: P7`, and the three expected relative output links (including that they resolve inside the case).
findings.why: This is removal of a consumer-observable test without removal of the production behavior. A regression that removes the successful-P7 `_project_readme` call passes every new F1–F5 test: the invalidation and chart-failure tests only require README to be active, and the direct report test correctly requires no completion. AC6's completed public demo and AC7's portable relative paths therefore lack a change-detecting seam.
Repository-wide search finds only its declaration. The recovery deleted the six proven-unused compatibility aliases but left this weightless API surface from the same earlier maintainability finding.
